hypothesis: an explicit pairwise residual trained on target-versus-current-proposal feature differences can recover cross-family signal from the 35 attributed ranker failures without replacing the frozen candidate universe or admission safety policy
unique_variable: replace the slot-10 proposal score with one linear pairwise residual learned from frozen rich candidate features plus the current ranker score

training_pairs.base_control: for every eligible target-present query group, compare the target with the current proposal, or with the highest-scoring non-target when current already proposes target
training_pairs.hard_case_extra: for current-policy misses where C100 contains target but current ranker never proposes it, add up to four additional highest-current-score negatives

model.features: 133 frozen semantic-off query-candidate features plus current-ranker score
model.score_rule: coef/scale dot candidate feature vector; pairwise intercept and center cancel

cross_fit.outer: product-family fold held out from residual and admission training
cross_fit.inner_residual: within each outer-train partition, train residual excluding one inner fold and score only that inner fold
cross_fit.inner_admission: train rescue/RR-regret heads on residual-OOF gate rows from other inner folds and select quantile on inner OOF
cross_fit.outer_serving: train residual on outer-train pairs; train admission on outer-train residual-OOF gate rows; map inner-selected quantile to outer-train unlabeled utility; apply to held outer fold

held_constant: P11 ranks 1-9 protection and slot-10-only swap
decision_rule: Promote only if every gate passes; otherwise close this residual formulation and use its proposal/oracle evidence to choose the next materially different mechanism
